prompt_md: A 200 m train travels at 20 m/s into a 400 m tunnel. How many seconds pass from the front entering to the last car leaving the tunnel?
prompt_short: 200 m train at 20 m/s, 400 m tunnel. Seconds from entering to fully out?
hint_md: Follow the very back of the train.
explain_intuition_md: The front only needs to cover the tunnel, but the back of the train starts 200 m behind it. It has to travel 600 m before it leaves the tunnel.
